## JagDroid v0.46 (experimental)

**Sound no longer drops out when a game runs slower than full speed.**

- In heavy scenes (reported in Power Drive Rally while racing) the emulator can fall below full speed, so sound was produced slower than it was played and the music and effects cut out.
- The audio queue now stretches smoothly when it runs low, so you may hear a slight pitch dip in the worst moments instead of silence.
- Desktop test runs of Power Drive Rally showed continuous sound through a race, so please tell me the on-screen FPS during a race if the dropouts continue.
